SECTION D

TROUBLE
Speedometer
Display disappears when rheostat is turned with light S/W ON

Only speedometer? → Yes → Replace speedometer
↓ No

Remove meter and connect
sub harness (SST)
↓

①With the ignition S/W at ON position, does voltage between terminals 1 and 16 of sub-harness vary from 0 to 9V when rheostat is turned?
↓ Yes → No

Is speedometer normal with other meters disconnected?
↓ Yes → No
↓
Connect other meters one by one to find faulty one. → Replace bad meter

②With the light S/W turned ON, does voltage between terminals TR and E of rheostat vary when rheostat is operated?
↓ No → Yes
↓
Bad wiring between rheostat and meter
↓
Check rheostat (See page BE-18)

Replace speedometer
